g.text: PROTECTED COMMIT / MEDIATED KEY RELEASE / ORIGINAL EXECUTION

text.tspan: Lost commits / concurrent requests / restart and old raw-key failures
Committed release / prefix agreement / original consumption and budget
Pod health grants no key authority
Staging is not permission to sign
CAS prefix promise and request row
No relabeling to a new context
Full inherited data and control prefix
Signature is not an execution permit
